name: Giant Revolt Advanced 2
why_interesting: Official mainland-China gravel complete bike with an exact GRX trim and suggested retail price.
price_status: official mainland suggested retail; stock and checkout unverified
required_before_dashboard: Complete-bike/frame weight; Exact wheel/tire build; Bottom-bracket standard; Numerical geometry and sizes; Current stock/checkout and warranty policy
source_note:
Current exact mainland and global manufacturer pages establish the trim, CNY 15,800 list price and qualified 45 mm 2x maximum. Giant publishes no controlled exact-frame stiffness result or standard complete-bike weight.

Batch 25 rechecked the current 2026 Giant UK 2× page: maximum 45 mm applies in the long flip-chip position; 53 mm is only for 1×. Treat this as UK specification evidence pending a mainland-trim match.
